710: def get_qat_qconfig(
711:     symmetric_activations: Optional[bool] = None,
712:     symmetric_weights: Optional[bool] = None,
713:     reduce_range: bool = False,
714:     activation_qconfig_kwargs: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
715:     weight_qconfig_kwargs: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
716:     activation_dtype: Optional[torch.dtype] = None,
717:     weight_dtype: Optional[torch.dtype] = None,
718:     activation_bits: Optional[int] = None,
719:     weight_bits: Optional[int] = None,
720: ) -> "torch.quantization.QConfig":
721:     """
722:     :param symmetric_activations: if True, activations will have a symmetric
723:         quantization range with a pre-specified zero point
724:         (0 if activation_dtype=torch.qint8, 128 if activation_dtype=torch.quint8).
725:         Default is False.
726:     :param symmetric_weights: if True, weights will have a symmetric
727:         quantization range with a pre-specified zero point
728:         (0 if weight_dtype=torch.qint8, 128 if weight_dtype=torch.quint8).
729:         Default is True.
730:     :param reduce_range: if True, the quantization range will be reduced by one bit.
731:         This may prevent overflow issues with model execution on certain hardware.
732:         Default is False.
733:     :param activation_qconfig_kwargs: Additional kwargs for quantization of
734:         activations.
735:     :param weight_qconfig_kwargs: Additional kwargs for quantization of
736:         weights.
737:     :param activation_dtype: quantized activation data type. Default is torch.quint8.
738:     :param weight_dtype: quantized weights data type. Default is torch.qint8.
739:     :param activation_bits: number of bits for activations. Default is 8.
740:     :param weight_bits: number of bits for weights. Default is 8.
741:     :return: A QAT fake quantization config for symmetric weight quantization and
742:         asymmetric activation quantization.  The difference between this and
743:         torch.quantization.default_qat_qconfig is that the activation observer
744:         will not have reduce_range enabled.
745:     """
746:     activation_observer = get_observer(
747:         symmetric_activations,
748:         activation_dtype,
749:         activation_bits,
750:         reduce_range,
751:         activation_qconfig_kwargs,
752:     )
753:     if symmetric_weights is None:
754:         _symmetric_weights = True
755:     else:
756:         _symmetric_weights = symmetric_weights
757: 
758:     if weight_dtype is None:
759:         _weight_dtype = torch.qint8
760:     else:
761:         _weight_dtype = weight_dtype
762: 
763:     weight_observer = get_observer(
764:         _symmetric_weights, _weight_dtype, weight_bits, False, weight_qconfig_kwargs
765:     )
766:     return torch_quantization.QConfig(
767:         activation=activation_observer,
768:         weight=weight_observer,
769:     )

772: def get_observer(
773:     symmetric: Optional[bool],
774:     dtype: Optional[torch.dtype],
775:     bits: Optional[int],
776:     reduce_range: bool,
777:     qconfig_kwargs: Dict[str, Any],
778: ):
779:     qscheme = torch.per_tensor_symmetric if symmetric else torch.per_tensor_affine
780:     quant_min, quant_max, dtype = compute_range(dtype, bits)
781:     observer_kwargs = dict(
782:         observer=torch_quantization.MovingAverageMinMaxObserver,
783:         quant_min=quant_min,
784:         quant_max=quant_max,
785:         dtype=dtype,
786:         qscheme=qscheme,
787:         reduce_range=reduce_range,
788:     )
789:     observer_kwargs.update(qconfig_kwargs or {})
790:     observer = torch_quantization.FakeQuantize.with_args(
791:         **observer_kwargs,
792:     )
793: 
794:     return observer

797: def fix_observer_quant_range(module: Module):
798:     """
799:     As of torch 1.10.2 there is a bug in FakeQuantize initialization where
800:     quant_min and quant_max of FakeQuantize are not propagated to its
801:     activation_post_process observer. This function propagates FakeQuantize quant
802:     ranges to their Observer objects
803: 
804:     :param module: Module object to propagate FakeQuantize quant ranges of. Propagates
805:         in place
806:     """
807:     for submodule in module.modules():
808:         if isinstance(submodule, torch_quantization.FakeQuantize):
809:             fake_quantize = submodule
810:         elif hasattr(submodule, "activation_post_process") and isinstance(
811:             submodule.activation_post_process, torch_quantization.FakeQuantize
812:         ):
813:             fake_quantize = submodule.activation_post_process
814:         else:
815:             continue
816: 
817:         # continue if fake_quantize quant range not set, or observer quant range is set
818:         observer = fake_quantize.activation_post_process
819:         if (
820:             fake_quantize.quant_min is None
821:             or fake_quantize.quant_max is None
822:             or (observer.quant_min is not None or observer.quant_max is not None)
823:         ):
824:             continue
825:         observer.quant_min = fake_quantize.quant_min
826:         observer.quant_max = fake_quantize.quant_max
827:         observer.has_customized_qrange = True
